# Zorvex Technologies

> Zorvex Technologies is a digital marketing agency in Himachal Pradesh, India, founded by Anil Sharma. It provides SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads management, GA4 conversion tracking and web development for businesses in the United States, Australia, the United Kingdom and India.

Key facts:

- Founder: Anil Sharma (https://anilsharma.co/), Top Rated Plus on Upwork with 100% Job Success and 500+ clients worldwide
- Services: technical, local and e-commerce SEO; Google Ads, Shopping and Performance Max; Meta Ads; AI search optimisation (GEO); GA4 tracking; websites on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow or custom code
- Clients include Trampolines.com, PDQuipment, NOMI, Noemi Professional US, Shop Marlowe Street, In-Ground Trampolines, Young Birdie Golf, Duncan & Stone Paper Co. and The Solar Lab
- Sister company: Uniq Web Infotech (https://uniqwebinfotech.com/)
- Contact: info@zorvextechnologies.com · +91 97793 39335

## About

- [SEO, Google Ads & Web Development Agency](https://zorvextechnologies.com/): Zorvex Technologies is a digital marketing agency for SEO, Google & Meta Ads, GA4 tracking and web development. Top Rated Plus on Upwork. Get a free audit.

## Services

- [SEO Services: Technical, Local & Ecommerce](https://zorvextechnologies.com/seo-services): Technical SEO, on-page optimisation, local SEO, Google Business Profile and content that grow organic traffic and leads. Get a free SEO audit today.
- [PPC Management: Google Ads & Meta Ads](https://zorvextechnologies.com/ppc-advertising): Google Ads, Shopping, Performance Max and Meta Ads management with proper conversion tracking, built for lower cost per lead and higher ROAS. Free ads audit.
- [Web Design & Development Services](https://zorvextechnologies.com/web-development): Fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow or custom code, designed to turn visitors into customers. Talk to Zorvex Technologies.

- [How AI Overviews & AI Mode Choose Sources (2026)](https://zorvextechnologies.com/blog/how-google-ai-overviews-ai-mode-choose-sources): Google published a guide on how AI Overviews and AI Mode pick and link sources. Here’s what it says and how to make your pages eligible to be cited.
- [GEO 2026: How to Get Cited by ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity](https://zorvextechnologies.com/blog/geo-generative-engine-optimization-2026-what-gets-cited): Generative Engine Optimization explained with 2026 research: what earns AI citations in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and how to measure it.
- [Google AI Mode Ads: Multiturn Ads & India Launch](https://zorvextechnologies.com/blog/google-ai-mode-ads-multiturn-ads-india): Google now shows ads on AI Mode follow-up questions and has expanded AI Mode ads to India, Australia and more. Here’s how to get your campaigns ready.
- [Google Ads Updates November 2026](https://zorvextechnologies.com/blog/google-ads-updates-november-2026): The Google Ads changes that matter this month: AI Max click tracking, the 7-day Smart Bidding learning limit, PMax income exclusions, purchase badges and more.
